# NYC Land Cover 2017

[Open in data browser](https://browser.portolan-sdi.org/#/external/data.source.coop/betanyc/nyc-land-cover-2017/catalog.json) · [Source repository](https://github.com/BetaNYC/nyc-land-cover-2017) · [Report a problem](https://github.com/BetaNYC/nyc-land-cover-2017/issues) · [Hosting repository](https://source.coop/betanyc/nyc-land-cover-2017)

A mirror of New York City's 2017 high-resolution land cover map, maintained by [BetaNYC](https://beta.nyc). The NYC Office of Technology and Innovation publishes the map on [NYC Open Data](https://data.cityofnewyork.us/d/he6d-2qns) as a zipped ERDAS Imagine file. This catalog carries it as a Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF that clients can read in place. Read the [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) before you query it.

## License

`other`. NYC Open Data states no license for this dataset. NYC Administrative Code section 23-502(d) makes public data sets available "without any registration requirement, license requirement or restrictions on their use", and lets the city require anyone who redistributes a data set to identify its source and version and describe any changes. This catalog does both in its attribution and provenance.

## Provenance

A mirror, not the official publication. The data comes from [NYC Open Data](https://data.cityofnewyork.us/d/he6d-2qns) and is maintained here by [BetaNYC](https://beta.nyc) (lab@beta.nyc). Metadata changes go through [the repository](https://github.com/BetaNYC/nyc-land-cover-2017).

## Access

Read the class at a point without downloading the file (GDAL 3.x, longitude then latitude):

<!-- check -->
```bash
gdallocationinfo -valonly -wgs84 \
  /vsicurl/https://data.source.coop/betanyc/nyc-land-cover-2017/land-cover-2017/nyc-land-cover-2017.tif \
  -73.9654 40.7829
```

The [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) has more recipes.
